cyber-security.title: KWES: Kapital Web Exposure Scanner
cyber-security.description: A configuration-driven orchestrator running seven security CLIs against assets an allowlist explicitly authorizes. Finds candidates, not vulnerabilities.

cyber-security.title: KC2: Kapital C2
cyber-security.description: A self-contained Node.js lab that reproduces npm lifecycle-script code execution end to end — a trojanized demo package, an outbound-only HTTP task broker, and an operator console — for security education and detection engineering.
